extDescription: Manages your Star Citizen hangar on robertsspaceindustries.com.

manager.title: Hangar Manager
manager.intro: An overview of your hangar. Use the refresh button at the top right to read the latest state from RSI.
manager.empty: No hangar data yet. Click the refresh button at the top right to read your hangar.
manager.searchPlaceholder: Search titles, ships and pledge IDs …

pledge.toggleDetails: Show or hide the contained items
pledge.surchargeTitle: Original price: $1. Pledge value: $2. That is $3 ($4) more than the original price.

settings.languageHint: Automatic uses the browser language if the extension is translated into it, English otherwise.
settings.hideMeltValueHint: Hides the $$ values in the hangar list.
settings.rewardsHint: Rewards are pledges with a value of $$0. Concierge and event rewards are recognized by their names.
settings.smartUpdatesHint: Checks the first, the last and a few more hangar pages for changes now and then, and updates the list without a full refresh.

buybackLinkOptions.list: The list page, scrolled to the pledge and highlighted

status.needsFullSync: Too many changes for a quick update.

ccugame.openInManagerBuyback: Open in Hangar Manager – Buy Back (#$1)

buyback.empty: No buy back data yet. Click the refresh button at the top right to read your hangar and buy back.
buyback.probablyGiftableHint: When bought back with real money (warbond), this item is probably giftable, as it was originally bought before $1.
buyback.addToCart: Add to cart on RSI and open the cart (new tab). RSI empties the cart for buy back pledges.
buyback.cartFailed: Could not add to the RSI cart: $1
buyback.cartNotFound: Not found at its stored position in RSI’s buy back any more – please sync and try again.
